svg.aria-label: Tactile graphic: Four chambers of the human heart
svg.title: Four chambers of the human heart
svg.desc: Right atrium, Left atrium, Right ventricle, Left ventricle

g.title: Right atrium
g.desc: Receives deoxygenated blood returning from systemic circulation via the venae cavae.

g.title: Left atrium
g.desc: Receives freshly oxygenated blood returning from the lungs through the pulmonary veins.

g.title: Right ventricle
g.desc: Pumps deoxygenated blood into the pulmonary artery toward the lungs for gas exchange.

g.title: Left ventricle
g.desc: Pumps oxygen-rich blood out through the aorta into systemic circulation.
